text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Local elections open to foreigners. Portugal gives the vote to residents from 20 countries where Portuguese emigrants have the same rights.

- Portugal close to Greece - according to a report on economic and social cohesion, regional differences have worsened in Portugal. Portuguese per capita GDP is one percent above that of Greece due low productivity and to high unemployment.
- Cape Verde and Mozambique will have stock markets in 1998 as a result of a cooperation programme between the Lisbon stock exchange and African countries with Portuguese as official language.
- Economy Ministry to review Sunday opening hours for hypermarkets.
- Various banks compete for privatisation of ANA - the national airport authority - which due next year.
- Ford to invest 74 billion escudos in Portugal over the next two or three years in Ford Electonics, Auto Europa and the compressors unit at Palmela.
- Sonae made 20 billion escudo profit in 1996.
